import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

pattern = r"\b(a|b|TMP)\s*<-\s*(a|b|TMP|\d+)\b"
for match in re.finditer(pattern, text):
    target, source = match.groups()
    values[target] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
